items.exampleZh: 幸運的人應該幫助別人。

items.exampleEn: He cried out in despair when he saw his broken bike.
items.exampleZh: 他看到腳踏車壞了，絕望地大叫。

items.exampleEn: Stop being such a tease and give me back my hat.
items.exampleZh: 別再當個愛捉弄人的傢伙了，把帽子還給我。

items.exampleEn: The view from the mountain was magnificent.
items.exampleZh: 從山上看出去的景色非常壯麗。

items.exampleEn: The end of the summer holiday always brings a little sadness.
items.exampleZh: 暑假結束總是帶來一點悲傷。

items.exampleEn: The fans cheered wildly when their team scored.
items.exampleZh: 球隊得分時，球迷們瘋狂地歡呼。

items.exampleEn: You have nothing to be ashamed of.
We were shocked to see snow in April.
items.exampleZh: 四月竟然下雪，我們都很震驚。

items.sentenceEn: The magnificent building took ten years to build.
items.sentenceZh: 這棟宏偉的建築花了十年才蓋好。

items.audioEn: I'm so ashamed. I forgot my best friend's birthday again.
items.audioZh: 我好羞愧，又忘了我最好朋友的生日。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼覺得羞愧？
options: Was late for a birthday party.

items.sentenceEn: She was shocked by the price of the bag.
items.sentenceZh: 她被那個包包的價格嚇到了。

items.sentenceEn: There was sadness in his voice.

items.stemEn: When the last train left without him, he was full of ____.
items.stemZh: 最後一班火車丟下他開走時，他陷入了絕望。

items.stemEn: The children ran ____ around the garden after the rain stopped.
items.stemZh: 雨停後，孩子們在花園裡瘋狂地跑來跑去。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family visited a magnificent old castle. My uncle, who is a big tease, told my little cousin that a ghost lived there. My cousin believed him and was scared. He started to cry, and the other visitors looked at us. My uncle felt ashamed, said sorry, and admitted the story was nonsense. Later, the guide told us the true story of the castle: long ago, a young prince lived there, and when his plan to build a great bridge failed, he fell into despair. The guide said there was still a feeling of sadness in the rooms. We felt fortunate that we could visit such a beautiful place. At the end, my cousin laughed wildly when my uncle slipped on the wet floor.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家參觀了一座壯麗的古堡。我叔叔很愛捉弄人，他告訴我的小表弟那裡住著一個鬼。表弟信以為真，嚇壞了，哭了起來，其他遊客都看著我們。叔叔覺得很羞愧，向他道歉，承認那個故事是胡說的。後來，導覽員告訴我們城堡的真實故事：很久以前，一位年輕的王子住在那裡，他建造一座大橋的計畫失敗後，就陷入了絕望。導覽員說，房間裡至今還有一股悲傷的氣氛。我們覺得很幸運，能參觀這麼美的地方。最後，叔叔在濕地板上滑了一跤，表弟笑得好瘋狂。

options: 他的玩笑把表弟弄哭了

questions.questionZh: 導覽員說王子後來怎麼了？
options: 成了一位受人愛戴的國王
搬到國外的一座城堡住

rubricZh: ashamed 表示「羞愧的」，例如 be ashamed of… 等說法

items.promptZh: 我們很幸運，那天天氣很好。
referenceEn: We were fortunate that the weather was good that day.
We were fortunate to have good weather that day.
rubricZh: 用 fortunate 表示「幸運的」（例如 were fortunate to…、were fortunate that… 等）
